patthana23.10:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo sekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā cha. na kusalaṃ na asekhaṃ
patthana23.10:2.1: dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato asekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. kusalaṃ na neva
patthana23.10:3.1: sekhanāsekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato nevasekhānāsekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā pañca, na kusalaṃ na parittaṃ
